title: Must Be True: Prove the inference (2026-10-03)

instruction_card.left_md:
# Prove the inference

Work untimed. Start by saying each rule as a complete if/then statement. Keep words such as "should" in your translation.

Write the sufficient condition on the left and the necessary condition on the right. For the contrapositive, reverse the direction and negate both sides.
instruction_card.right_md:
# Four questions, difficulty 3-3

1. Identify the conditional indicators.
2. Diagram the rules and connect any matching terms.
3. Use the facts to trigger a rule or its contrapositive.
4. Choose the answer you can prove. Explain which statements prove it before checking the explanation.

Do not reverse a rule without negating both sides.

Joshua
